Bilkul sahi: 4 × 3 = 12, toh rang wale 2 × 3 = 6. Yeh number line 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar gap mein kati hai. Beech ka mark 4/8 hai, aur wahi 1/2 bhi hai aur 2/4 bhi. Toh 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8: ek jagah, teen naam. Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: Isi line par 0 se chalkar 3/4 tak pahunchna hai. 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: 4 se baat nahi bani. Pehle dekho ki 0 se 1/4 tak 1/8 wale kitne gap aate hain. Phir socho ki 3/4 mein aise kitne 1/4 hain. 0 se 3/4 tak pahunchne ke liye, is line par 1/8 wale kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: 7 sahi nahi hai. 3/4 ka matlab 3 gap nahi hai: is line ka har gap 1/8 hai, jo 1/4 se chhota hai, isliye 3/4 tak 3 se zyada gap lagenge. Apna jawab tum khud bolo.

Yeh jawab nahi hai. Neeche 5 ko 2 se guna kiya, isliye upar ke 3 ko bhi 2 se hi guna karenge. Upar 3 × 2 = 6 hua, toh 3/5 aur 6/10 barabar hain. Ab doosra fraction: uska neeche wala number 15 hai. 3/5 ke barabar is fraction ka upar wala number kya hoga?
director.card: Ab doosra fraction: uska neeche wala number 15 hai. 3/5 ke barabar is fraction ka upar wala number kya hoga?

Sahi jawab, kyunki neeche 3 × 4 = 12 hua, toh upar bhi 1 × 4 = 4, yaani 1/3 = 4/12. Ek fraction 3/4 ke barabar hai, aur uska neeche 8 hai. Upar kaunsa number likhoge?

director.text: 6 hoga
Haan, sahi hai. Neeche 4 × 2 = 8 hua, toh upar bhi 3 × 2 = 6; 4 jodkar 7 nahi. 1/4 ke barabar kaunsa fraction hai: 1/12, 3/12 ya 9/12?
director.card: 1/4 ke barabar kaunsa fraction hai: 1/12, 3/12 ya 9/12?

director.text: Bilkul sahi: neeche 4 × 3 = 12, toh upar 1 × 3 = 3, yaani 3/12; 1/12 mein upar guna nahi hua. Ab barabar fraction banana aa gaya. Ab ulta kaam: do fraction diye hon, toh kaise pata karein ki woh barabar hain ya nahi. Yahan tak saaf hai?
thak gayi, bye
Thak jaana theek hai; thoda aaram karo aur paani pi lo. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge!
